items.name: Brisket plate
items.description: Sliced brisket with sides on the canyon patio — the park's planned-stop meal.
items.verdict: Solid portions at park prices, in the best lunch location Great America has. Order the plate.

items.name: Hot fudge sundae
items.description: A proper parlor sundae — hot fudge, whipped cream, a cherry — served at a table in the air conditioning.
items.verdict: The single best dessert at the park and the best heat-recovery move. Split one; do not fight over the last bite alone.

items.name: Churro
items.description: Cinnamon-sugar churro from the harbor midway carts.
items.verdict: The reliable walking snack. Buy two; the first one vanishes.
